items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: And I worked with Abbie at the, at the, at the Metri Inn. For about three years. And I worked with him at the Silver Slipper for about three years.

ctx.x: Well, this Owls Hall, it was just about a block down from the ferry landing. And they would do, if they caught you fooling, the fellas over there would go up the fellas from New Orleans fooling with any of the girls. Well, they'd do either one of two things. They'd either run them up the levee and down the ferry landing. If the ferry wasn't in, don't stop, just keep going, you know. Either that or the two fellas would get the guy, one by the arms and one by the legs and take him by a window like that and swing…
You ever played any of his bands? No, I never did.
